description: Source code for the VideoDecodeStatsRecorder class, which manages recording and updating video decode statistics, including starting new records, updating existing ones, and finalizing records. It interacts with other components via callbacks and data structures related to video decoding performance.

classes.name: VideoDecodeStatsRecorder
classes.description: A class responsible for recording video decode statistics, managing the lifecycle of a record, and communicating with a storage or logging system via callbacks.

methods.name: VideoDecodeStatsRecorder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recorder with callback, source ID, origin, top frame flag, and player ID.

methods.name: ~VideoDecodeStatsRecorder
methods.description: Destructor that finalizes the record upon object destruction.

methods.name: StartNewRecord
methods.description: Begins a new recording session with specified prediction features, finalizing any existing record.

methods.name: UpdateRecord
methods.description: Updates the current record with new prediction target data.

methods.name: FinalizeRecord
methods.description: Finalizes and saves the current record if valid, otherwise does nothing.
